findings.message: SVG text viewBox overflow in fig-U1-1 and fig-U1-3 (4 files total: light and dark variants). Site wordmark textbook.com.pk extends to x=814.3, overflowing the 780px viewBox right edge by 34.3px to 34.6px. Root cause: CSS rule text { text-anchor: middle } overrides presentation attribute text-anchor="end" on <text class="wm" x="768" ...>. Repair: add text-anchor: end to .wm CSS class rule or remove text-anchor: middle from the global text selector in static/img/figures/geng-300/unit-01/fig-U1-1.svg, fig-U1-1.dark.svg, fig-U1-3.svg, and fig-U1-3.dark.svg.

RRQ 3 mark scheme arithmetic discrepancy in docs/semester-1/geng-300/unit-01/unit-assessment.mdx:182-184. The stem asks to Name the four word-formation processes and give one example of each with header (4 marks). The mark scheme allocates 4 marks for naming processes (Names all four processes: affixation, compounding, clipping, back formation (1 each)) PLUS up to 4 marks for examples (One mark per example that correctly illustrates the process (up to 4)), totaling 8 payable marks. Repair: align the stem mark total and scheme breakdown (e.g., allocate 0.5 mark per process name and 0.5 mark per example for 4 marks total, or allocate 1 mark per pair of process + valid example, or adjust total to 8 marks).

RRQ 4 grammatical classification error in stem and mark scheme in docs/semester-1/geng-300/unit-01/unit-assessment.mdx:107-109 and 185-188. The sentence After the meeting ended, the teachers went to the staffroom and discussed the new timetable consists of one dependent clause (After the meeting ended) and one independent clause with a compound predicate (the teachers went to the staffroom and discussed the new timetable). It is a complex sentence, not compound-complex. The mark scheme erroneously credits classifying it as compound-complex and asserts discussed the new timetable is an independent clause, despite it lacking a subject. Repair: update the sentence stem to provide a genuine compound-complex structure (e.g. After the meeting ended, the teachers went to the staffroom, and they discussed the new timetable or ... and the headteacher discussed the new timetable) so that both independent clauses contain explicit subjects and verbs, or revise the mark scheme and classification to complex.

Check your understanding item 3 in docs/semester-1/geng-300/unit-01/topic-02.mdx:101-102 repeats the compound predicate structure: After the rain stopped, the children went outside and played in the mud. Like RRQ 4, played in the mud is a coordinate predicate sharing the subject the children, making this sentence complex rather than compound-complex. Repair: add a subject to the second coordinate verb (e.g., and they played in the mud) if intended as an example of a compound-complex sentence.
